expect_red: six nodes are too few to prove a cylinder by its nodes alone

mutations.contract: A cylinder has five degrees of freedom, so six nodes sit on SOME cylinder to almost nothing whatever surface they came from. The node test needs cylinderNodeMinVertices nodes, enough to over-determine one, before an exact fit means anything.
mutations.note: The mutation deletes the node-count gate; a six-node band then fits exactly and answers cylindrical on a fit that could not have failed.
